issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for class GroverKakuro: In the template (template_repository/ex5_grover_kakuro.py) the class defines __init__(self, size: int) (expects a 'size' parameter). In the solution (solution_repository/ex5_grover_kakuro.py) the class defines __init__(self) with no parameter. This divergence in the constructor API can confuse students about how to instantiate the solver (whether to pass a size) and may cause example usage or tests to fail if they assume one signature or the other.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor signature consistent. Preferred fix: remove the unused 'size' parameter from the template and change def __init__(self, size: int) to def __init__(self): so the template and solution match the 2x2 Kakuro description. Alternatively, if variable-size Kakuro was intended, add a size: int parameter to the solution's __init__ and use or document it, and update the problem statement to explain the parameter. Update any example instantiations/tests to match the chosen signature.
